use default

power_of_two(exponent: int) -> int =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        1
    else
        2 * power_of_two(exponent - 1)
    fi

indent(width: int) -> string =>
    if width <= 0 then
        ""
    else
        " {indent(width - 1)}"
    fi

row(number: int) -> string =>
    (0::number)
        |> map(column =>
            if (number & column) == column then "*" else " " fi)
        |> join(" ")

let size = power_of_two(4)

(0..size)
    |> each(number =>
        write_line("{indent(size - 1 - number)}{row(number)}"))
